provenance: Facility coordinates held by the original app's facility dictionary (getfacilitydictionary), exported 2026-11-18. Coordinates were derived by the §10 rule (Nominatim, facility name as-is, in-park-range candidates, fixed-order variants) and verified in the 2026-11-18 full census: of the 48 facilities where both the dictionary and the rule hold coordinates, 46 matched at 0 m distance. Two entries are facility-specific values whose provenance could NOT be verified (unresolved through every step of the rule, including English names); they are marked "provenance": "unverified" on the entry itself. Scope: real facilities only, following the census universe (Sea 39 / Land 32 facilities; this file lists the 55 that hold coordinates). Dictionary rows that are plan-item labels (entry/exit, purchases, rests, meals, movement) and test residue are excluded even when they carry coordinates. Parkwide shows and harbor shows listed here carry the entrance-area representative point (see area-points.json), not a name-matched location — that is by design (§10 parkwide rule).
